evidence.description: Mutable instance state 'items' is declared without isolation.
Access and modification of 'items' occurs within a concurrent completion handler.

candidates.explanation: The 'items' property is a mutable instance state (Set<Item>) that is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts (specifically via the completion handler of 'session.dataTask' and the main queue) without any actor isolation or synchronization mechanism.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
